subject: english
question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose "No error'.

He straightened up in the seat and taken a sip of his cold coffee.

options.text: the seat and taken a sip

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect verb tense usage.
 
• The verb "taken" should be "took" to match the past tense of the sentence.
 
• The correct phrase should be "**the seat and took a sip**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 2** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"He straightened up in the seat and took a sip of his cold coffee."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• No error – This would be the correct option if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is an error in part 2.
 
• 3: "of his cold coffee." – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **4: "He straightened up in" **– This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
